channel.title: Eugenio Nerelli: writing
channel.description: Eugenio Nerelli builds open source developer tools and desktop apps that run on a laptop and keep their data there. PhD student at the University of València, moving into mechanistic interpretability.

item.title: One prompt injection out of six got through
item.description: Testing an LLM job scheduler against hostile input, what the failing case looked like, and what a successful injection buys.

item.title: Everything runs on the laptop
item.description: Four of these tools do the work on one machine with no account behind them. What that constraint costs: CPU transcription times, disk space for local models, unsigned builds, and dependencies that cannot be bundled.
